findings_qualitative.value: HRL profiles are Voigt with Lorentzian wings, signature of Stark broadening

evidence.quote: The HRLs exhibit Voigt profiles, a strong signature of Stark broadening.

findings_qualitative.value: SO, 34SO, SO2 low-energy lines show a velocity gradient perpendicular to the jet; OCS and CS do not

evidence.quote: The molecular core exhibits a velocity gradient perpendicular to the jet-axis, which we interpret as evidence of rotation.

claims.hypothesis: Can a slow ionized wind in LTE explain the continuum and HRLs without high-velocity gas?
claims.experiment: Modeled the 1-100 GHz continuum and the three HRLs with an isothermal conical wind model
claims.result: Predicted line fluxes and shapes consistent with data with Ne0 ~2e7 cm-3 at 100 AU

evidence.quote: We successfully reproduce the observed continuum and HRLs simultaneously using a simple model of a slow ionized wind in local thermodynamic equilibrium, with no need a high-velocity component.

claims.experiment: Voigt fits to H40a, H42a, H50b

evidence.quote: The estimated dynamical mass is $56\mbox{$\,M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$}$.

why_this_method.value: HRLs probe velocity of ionized gas directly, which was previously assumed from lobe proper motions

evidence.quote: The dominant assumption in the literature has been that the velocity of the ionized gas within the jet is similar to that of the lobes.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: High-velocity outflowing gas producing the wings was disfavored because a Lorentz-like symmetric shape would be fortuitous and no red/blue peak shift >0.2" was found

evidence.quote: It would be fortuitous, however, if the ionized wings produced by entraining ambient gas had a Lorentz-like and a symmetric shape.

limitations_admitted.value: Model parameters not tightly constrained; selection heuristic

evidence.quote: The most important caveat associated with the model is that the data constraints on the parameters are not tight.

limitations_admitted.value: Spectral resolution gives only two samples per FWHM so line profile modeling not attempted

evidence.quote: This sampling is too scarce to attempt a detailed modeling of the line profiles.
